claims: Chuck Norris and Bruce Lee faced off in the 1972 film The Way of the Dragon
The Way of the Dragon is also known as Return of the Dragon
Chuck Norris played Colt in The Way of the Dragon
Colt fought Bruce Lee in the Roman Colosseum in The Way of the Dragon
The Way of the Dragon marked an early film role for Chuck Norris
Chuck Norris was a champion fighter
Chuck Norris was a friend of Bruce Lee
